name: SlateStub
tagline: Enterprise-grade payroll for the people behind the camera.
positioning: SlateStub is the payroll platform of record for independent production companies — timecards, unions, and pay stubs, reconciled to the frame.

hero.h1: Production payroll that closes the week in one pass.
hero.sub: SlateStub turns crew timecards, union rules, and daily rates into compliant pay stubs and W-2s — so owner-operators can wrap the shoot instead of the paperwork.

features.title: Timecards to stubs, automatically
features.description: Import daily timecards, apply IATSE and Teamster rate rules, and generate audited pay stubs before the crew leaves set.

features.title: Union math, handled
features.description: Meal penalties, turnaround, and fringe contributions calculate to the minute against the right agreement — no spreadsheet gymnastics.

features.title: Multi-project cost reports
features.description: Roll labor costs into per-production budgets your line producer and accountant can both reconcile in real time.

features.title: Year-end filed for you
features.description: W-2s, 1099s, and multi-state withholding filed on schedule, with residency splits tracked across every shoot day.

features.title: Crew self-service portal
features.description: Cast and crew view stubs, update deposits, and download tax forms without emailing your production office.

features.title: Audit-ready records
features.description: Every rate change, approval, and payment is timestamped and exportable for payroll audits and completion bonds.

testimonials.quote: We used to close payroll on Sunday nights with three spreadsheets and a prayer. SlateStub reconciled our first commercial in under an hour, meal penalties and all.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ferraro

testimonials.quote: The union rules are the part that used to keep me up at night. Now turnaround and fringes calculate themselves, and my accountant stopped sending me angry emails.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ozawa

testimonials.quote: As a two-person shop, we needed enterprise controls without an enterprise team. SlateStub gave us audit-ready stubs the bond company approved on the first pass.
testimonials.name: Priya Ravel
